title: Well-formed phased migration — additive + batched backfill + validator progression
expected_feedback: No violations. Phased, and each phase carries the property that makes it safe: the index build is the replicated default with per-secondary lag monitoring; the backfill carries no cursor at all -- the predicate selects each batch, which is correct for any _id BSON type (a $gt keyset would type-bracket and strand every _id of a different type), states w:'majority', and throttles; the validator is staged moderate -> counted verification -> strict; and the $unset cleanup is deferred to a separate release because it cannot be reversed without the old value.
